description: This file defines the class 'testproject', which manages test project data within the TestLink open source testing platform. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving test projects, along with handling related entities like keywords, requirements, and roles. The class also contains functions to generate hierarchical maps of test suites and requirements, manage session data, and interact with associated database tables and other classes for comprehensive test project management.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class responsible for managing test project data, including creation, updating, deletion, and related entities within the TestLink framework.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test project entity with specified parameters such as name, color, notes, options, activity status, prefix, and visibility. Inserts the new project into the database and initializes session data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing test project's details in the database including name, color, notes, options, activity status, prefix, and public status. Also updates session data and triggers related events.

methods.name: setSessionProject
methods.description: Sets or unsets session variables related to the current test project based on the provided project ID.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a test project record from the database by its name with optional additional clause.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Fetches a test project record by its unique ID.

methods.name: get_by_prefix
methods.description: Retrieves test project data using its prefix identifier.

methods.name: getByAPIKey
methods.description: Returns a test project associated with a given API key.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Fetches all test projects, optionally filtered and sorted based on parameters.

methods.name: get_accessible_for_user
methods.description: Retrieves a list of test projects accessible to a specific user, considering roles and permissions.

methods.name: get_subtree
methods.description: Gets a subtree of project nodes starting from a specific project, considering filters and options for recursion and node exclusion.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a Smarty template rendering the details view for a test project, including attachments and permissions.

methods.name: count_testcases
methods.description: Counts total test cases associated with a specific test project, regardless of active status.

methods.name: gen_combo_test_suites
methods.description: Generates a hierarchical mapping of test suites for a project suitable for dropdown combos, with indentation based on hierarchy.

methods.name: checkName
methods.description: Validates the name of a test project for emptiness and illegal characters.

methods.name: checkNameSintax
methods.description: Checks the syntax correctness of a test project name, similar to checkName.

methods.name: checkNameExistence
methods.description: Verifies if a test project with the same name already exists, excluding a specified ID.

methods.name: checkTestCasePrefixExistence
methods.description: Checks if a test case prefix is already used by another project, excluding a specified ID.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a test project based on the status parameter.

methods.name: formatTcPrefix
methods.description: Trims and limits the length of a test case prefix string.

methods.name: getTestCasePrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the prefix of a test project by its ID.

methods.name: generateTestCaseNumber
methods.description: Generates a new test case number for a project, incrementing a counter with file locking to prevent race conditions.

methods.name: setTestCaseCounter
methods.description: Sets the test case counter for a project to a specific value.

methods.name: setPublicStatus
methods.description: Sets the project as public or private.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Creates and associates a new keyword with a test project.

methods.name: updateKeyword
methods.description: Updates an existing keyword associated with a test project.

methods.name: getKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves a keyword by its ID.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Fetches all keywords linked to a specific test project.

methods.name: deleteKeyword
methods.description: Deletes a keyword by ID with optional checks and audit logging.

methods.name: deleteKeywords
methods.description: Deletes all keywords associated with a test project.

methods.name: getKeywordIDsFor
methods.description: Fetches IDs of keywords linked to a specific test project.

methods.name: getKeywordSet
methods.description: Retrieves all keywords for a test project as a map of ID to keyword.

methods.name: hasKeywords
methods.description: Checks if a test project has any associated keywords.

methods.name: exportKeywordsToXML
methods.description: Exports the project keywords as an XML string.

methods.name: exportKeywordsToCSV
methods.description: Exports the project keywords as a CSV string.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromCSV
methods.description: Imports keywords from a CSV file into the test project.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromXMLFile
methods.description: Imports keywords from an XML file into the test project.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromXML
methods.description: Imports keywords from an XML string into the test project.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Imports keywords from a SimpleXML object into the test project.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Returns a map of keyword IDs to their names for a given test project.

methods.name: getUsedKeywordsMap
methods.description: Returns a map of keywords linked to test cases within the project.

methods.name: getOptionReqSpec
methods.description: Retrieves requirement specifications for a test project, optionally filtering non-empty ones.

methods.name: genComboReqSpec
methods.description: Creates a hierarchical association of requirement specifications, for selection UI, with tree indentation.

methods.name: getReqSpec
methods.description: Gets requirement specification data, optionally for a specific ID, including textual info and metadata.

methods.name: createReqSpec
methods.description: Creates a new System Requirements Specification (SRS) for a project.

methods.name: get_srs_by_title
methods.description: Fetches SRS entries by title and project ID, with optional case-insensitivity.

methods.name: check_srs_title
methods.description: Checks whether an SRS title is valid and not duplicate within the project.
